title: 36 Hours in Dresden, Germany
abstract: History never feels out of reach in the capital of Saxony, lush with avant-garde art, restored Baroque architecture and one of Europe’s oldest Christmas markets.

title: 36 Hours in Toulouse, France
abstract: The riverside, red-brick city in southwestern France, already a hub for aerospace technology, is undergoing a cultural rebirth with the reopening of several top art museums.

title: 36 Hours in San Luis Obispo County
abstract: Wineries and boutique hotels have sprouted along the backroads and once-sleepy main streets of this Central Coast county.

title: 36 Hours in Park City, Utah
abstract: More than 2,000 acres of new ski area add to the allure of this sporty mecca with a thriving cultural scene.
